nyc_equity.reason: Exploratory tract association; HC3 intervals do not correct spatial dependence or ACS sampling error.
nyc_equity.formula: log_access ~ log_income + poverty_pct + youth_pct + older_pct + log_density + C(borough)

access_loneliness.reason: 2023 CDC modeled outcome vs current facilities; ACS shares overlap model inputs; temporal mismatch and ecological inference prevent causal claims.
access_loneliness.formula: loneliness_pct ~ log_access + log_income + poverty_pct + youth_pct + older_pct + log_density + C(borough)

library_did.reason: No verified branch-level treatment dates, matched untreated controls, and aligned repeated pre/post local outcomes. CDC PLACES is unsuitable for intervention evaluation. See docs/models/library_did.md.

atus.reason: Official multi-year archive unavailable; age 15–24 estimates are not generated. Offline mode: missing data/raw/atus/atussum-0324.zip

nyc_supplements.reason: Library GIS and Parks acquisition geometries downloaded separately. Not added to FacDB exposure to avoid cross-source duplicates; acquisitions are not distinct parks.

panel.reason: NY 62 counties, 2018–2023: 372/372 usable current rows; 8/8 county/year FE models estimated; 0 source failures. NAICS 722515 is a snack/nonalcoholic beverage bar proxy; BFS measures applications, not formations.
caveats: ACS annual 5-year estimates overlap; population uncertainty is not propagated.
County BFS counts have disclosure-avoidance noise and IRS processing-year boundaries.
Observational associations do not identify cafe effects or actual business births.

third_place_index.reason: Compiled index redistribution permission unresolved. Source identifies OSM ODbL and public-domain Census inputs, without a separate compiled-index grant. Restricted local research only; do not redistribute archive or tract-level derivatives.
third_place_index.output_policy: Schema, inventory, QA counts and pooled correlations only; no GEOIDs or tract-level values.

atus_published.reason: Official published all-15+ socializing/communicating series only, 2003-2024; no 2020 annual estimate. This does not complete the ages 15-24/T120101 microdata analysis.
atus_published.population: U.S. civilian noninstitutional population age 15 and over; all persons; all days
atus_published.definition_verification: API endpoints reconciled to independently inspected 2003 and 2024 official BLS Table 1 total-population values; no API catalog title is assumed.
caveats: Published aggregate is not equivalent to detailed T120101 or total face-to-face interaction.
Published hours are rounded; minutes are a unit conversion, not additional precision.
No annual survey confidence intervals or regression inference are supplied.
All-15+ results cannot establish the trend for ages 15-24.
